title: CIDetectionResult
description: Result of convention-based CI command detection for a workspace.

lint_command.description: Shell command to run lint/style checks. Null when no linter detected.

test_command.description: Shell command to run tests. Null when no test runner detected.

detected_from.description: File or convention that triggered detection (e.g. '.rubocop.yml', 'pyproject.toml').
